query_rule: All 16 existing source-hash-panel queries, not previous target winners. Source-only task screening; no target map coefficients or target endpoints used.

design.scope: One across-PP structural family, 16 lexicalized templates per split; not 32 independent syntactic structures. Programmatic synthetic grammatical labels, not human annotations. No claim of exclusion from base-model pretraining. Reserved prompts generated but not tokenized or forwarded this run.

primary: log P(correct is/are)-log P(incorrect is/are) in recipient context; interventions measured as baseline minus intervened margin
secondary: past was/were agreement margin and present-versus-past total probability log ratio; neither is independent human semantic evidence
intervention: Only final valid prompt position at existing layer5 resid_post. Donor differs only in subject number or only in attractor number. Source local candidate-code donor difference projected onto saved rank1 b, shared per-input source hook cap0.1; independent means cancel. Raw-hook donor swap uses its own cap0.1 and is a capacity diagnostic, not identical-energy FCC control.
budget_description: 64 dev prompts: 8 baseline+8 noop+16 raw swaps+256 source query swap batches at8. Short unpadded-length<=64, <=3min numerical run, model loading/hash prep separate<=1min; existing runtime and five SAEs, no fitting/audit/new weights. Extra2 unpadded equivalence forwards allowed as correctness checks.
selection: Rank all16 source queries by mean signed subject-swap primary margin loss across64development prompts (equal template weights), atom/seed tie; shortlist top2 with entire ranking/attractor effects retained. No target results used; negative/weak signal reported rather than silently excluded.

padding_tolerances.scope: Separate unit-scaled float32 diagnostic after v1 max0.0003752576; fixed before v2 source interventions, not a scientific acceptance threshold.
